Jāli：1．Jāli．-Son of Vessantara and Maddī，and brother of Kanhajinā．He and his sister were given to Jūjaka as slaves，but were later rescued by the intervention of Sakka．Jāli led the army which brought Vessantara back from his hermitage．He is identified with Rāhula （J．vi．487ff； cp．i．9）．See the Vessantara Jātaka．

Jāli is probably also the king of the same name given in a list of Okkāka’s descendants，and stated to have succeeded Vessantara （E．g．，Mhv．ii．13； Dpv．iii．42）．

The gift of Jāli as a slave is considered one of the greatest sacrifices made by the Bodhisatta．J．i．77； AA．i．64； DhA．i．406； Mil．275，282，etc．



2．Jāli．-The name of two Pacceka Buddhas，occurring in a nominal list．M．iii．70； ApA．i．107．

pn: Jālinī 01. One of the five queens of the third Okkāka king. DN-a.i.258; Mhv-ṭ.131; Snp-a.i.352.

jāliya.p: [¿] CL=8 Wandering ascetic called jāliya
pn:
Jāliya. A paribbājaka who, with his friend Maṇḍissa, visited the Buddha at the Ghositārāma (DN.i.159). The Buddha preached to them the Jāliyasutta (q.v.). According to the Pāṭikasutta, when Jāliya heard that Pāṭika could not come to hold a discussion with the Buddha at Vesālī, he went to the Tindukkhānaparibbājakārāma and tried to get Pāṭikaputta to come. But the latter was unable to come, being fixed in his seat. Jāliya thereupon spoke insultingly to him, calling him boaster, etc. (DN.iii.22ff).

Jāliya is described as dārupattakantevāsī, because, says the Commentary (DN-a.i.319), his teacher used to beg for alms with a wooden bowl.

jāliyasutta.p: [Jāliya+sutta] (na) Google Translate Zaliya Sutta While the Buddha was reciting the Dhamma at the Gosita Temple in Kosambi, the wanderer Montiya and Zaliya came to the Lord and said, 'Lord Gotama! Is even life called 'life' a body called 's ရr ရီ'? Or is it biologically different? ' Then the Buddha said to the wanderer Mondiya and Zaliya: 'I should not teach that life and matter are one and the same thing.'
pn: Jāliyasutta. Preached to Jāliya and Maṇḍissa at the Ghositārāma on the question as to whether body and soul are one and the same. DN.i.159f. The Sutta is identical with the second part of the Mahālisutta and was once probably included in it.
a: ဇာလိယသုတ္တ(န)

ဇာလိယသုတ်၊ ဘုရားရှင်သည် ကောသမ္ဗီပြည်ဃောသိတာရုံကျောင်း၌ သီတင်းသုံးနေတော်မူစဉ် မုဏ္ဍိယပရိဗိုဇ်နှင့် ဇာလိယပရိဗိုဇ်တို့သည် ဘုရားရှင်၏ ထံတော်မှောက်သို့ ဝင်ရောက်၍ 'အရှင်ဂေါတမ၊ 'ဇီဝ' ခေါ်သော အသက်သည်ပင် 'သရီရ'ခေါ်သော ခန္ဓာကိုယ် ဖြစ်ပါသလော၊ သို့မဟုတ် ဇီဝတခြား သရီရတခြား ဖြစ်ပါသလော'ဟု လျှောက်ထားမေးမြန်းကြလေသည်။ ထိုအခါ ဘုရားရှင်သည် 'ဇီဝနှင့် သရီရသည် အတူတူပင် ဟူ၍လည်းကောင်း, ဇီဝတခြား သရီရတခြားဟူ၍လည်းကောင်း ငါဘုရား မဟောကြားအပ်ပေ'ဟု မုဏ္ဍိယနှင့် ဇာလိယပရိဗိုဇ်တို့အား ဟောကြားအပ်သောသုတ်။

Jāli：1．Jāli．-Son of Vessantara and Maddī，and brother of Kanhajinā．He and his sister were given to Jūjaka as slaves，but were later rescued by the intervention of Sakka．Jāli led the army which brought Vessantara back from his hermitage．He is identified with Rāhula （J．vi．487ff； cp．i．9）．See the Vessantara Jātaka．

Jāli is probably also the king of the same name given in a list of Okkāka’s descendants，and stated to have succeeded Vessantara （E．g．，Mhv．ii．13； Dpv．iii．42）．

The gift of Jāli as a slave is considered one of the greatest sacrifices made by the Bodhisatta．J．i．77； AA．i．64； DhA．i．406； Mil．275，282，etc．



2．Jāli．-The name of two Pacceka Buddhas，occurring in a nominal list．M．iii．70； ApA．i．107．
